text: {"features":[{"evidence":"7 years of software development experience","name":"Professional experience duration","description":"Captures how much full-time software engineering tenure the letter explicitly claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Look for stated years: about 2 to 3 years, or only minimum-level tenure."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Look for stated years: about 4 to 5 years of professional software engineering."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Look for stated years: 6 or more years of professional software engineering."}]},{"evidence":"tested, maintained, and launched 6 production services","name":"Production service ownership","description":"Captures the breadth of direct responsibility the applicant claims for real production systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions production work only vaguely, or cites ownership of up to 2 services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Cites ownership of roughly 3 to 4 production services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Cites ownership of 5 or more production services with clear testing, maintenance, or launch responsibility."}]},{"evidence":"Bachelor's degree / Master's degree / Doctoral degree","name":"Degree level","description":"Captures the highest formal academic qualification explicitly stated in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience only."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree in computer science or a related field."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree in computer science or a related field."}]},{"evidence":"Go as my daily driver alongside 9 other languages","name":"Language breadth","description":"Captures how broad a programming-language toolkit the letter claims beyond Go tools."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major production tool with strong quality signals, such as daily use, typed or tested services, or organization-wide tooling level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Ties AI work to production behavior, reliability, or failure-mode awareness."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Adds explicit evaluation, hardening, deployment scaffolding, or other operational controls for production AI systems."}]},{"evidence":"Python agents ... Go services define their permissions and audit their actions","name":"Agentic tooling architecture","description":"Captures the depth of direct experience designing agent-based systems rather than merely naming them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic or agent-based tooling mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or agentic pipelines, but without architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete split between Python agents and Go back-end services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains how agents are bounded, constrained, permissioned, logged, or audited, showing operational control rather than just architecture."}]},{"evidence":"classified, deduplicated, and attached to the right owner","name":"Vulnerability triage automation mentioned, or only a general interest in automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Says they automated vulnerability handling, but gives little detail about what the system did."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes concrete functions such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or queue transformation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Also explains the operational effect, such as reducing manual triage, returning expert time, or making the workflow largely self-serve."}]},{"evidence":"threat modeling and code review for common vulnerability classes","name":"Security assessment practice","description":"Captures whether the applicant shows hands-on security review work and how methodical that work sounds.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security assessments or reviews mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security reviews or assessments only generically."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Names concrete practices such as threat models, attack-surface mapping, code review, or remediation verification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames assessments as systematic engineering work with clear process, follow-through, or a builder's-eye perspective on design assumptions and fixes."}]},{"evidence":"replaced ad-hoc traversals with proper graph algorithmic evidence, or no mention of data structures and algorithms."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength, but without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a specific redesign, optimization, or structure-choice example."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a specific example tied to a hard production bottleneck, high-throughput path, or substantial system simplification."}]},{"evidence":"maintain an open-source project with a genuine user community","name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"Captures whether the applicant merely consumes open fixes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Maintains a project or library with reviews or releases."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Maintains a project with external users or a real community, plus ongoing stewardship such as roadmap, issue handling, or release ownership."}]},{"evidence":"built a distributed job scheduler with leader election and crash recovery","name":"Personal project very small utility with little technical depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a modest finished side project, useful but technically limited."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a substantial design tradeoffs."}]},{"evidence":"OSCP certification / CompTIA Security+ certification","name":"Security certification","description":"Captures whether the letter offers a formal external security Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a hands-on offensive certification such as OSCP."}]},{"evidence":"capture-the-flag competitions ... near the top","name":"Offensive competitive CTFs."}]},{"evidence":"strengthening the development lifecycle itself","name":"Role comprehension","description":"Captures how specifically the letter reflects the actual charter of this particular role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions one posted responsibility, qualification, or keyword from the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly connects the role to lifecycle security analysis, Go back ends, Python agents, and organization-wide impact."}]},{"evidence":"improvements are inherited by every team downstream","name":"Foundational leverage with security engineers or internal users, such as learning from specialists, comparing notes, or building closely with the teams served."}]},{"evidence":"queue went from a dreaded chore to something assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly generic claims about strengths or fit, with little concrete evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mixes general claims with a few concrete read."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clean or nearly clean copy with no distracting mistakes."}]},{"evidence":"software that guards other software must be built to a higher standard","name":"Distinctive interest.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Formulaic opening and generic statement of interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Clear rationale for applying, but phrased maintenance.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No maintainer lens beyond ordinary engineering claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Indirect signals such as testing, maintenance, or operating inherited services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicit reflection on inheritance, durability, failure, or maintenance as a core engineering value."}]}]}
